components.name: System Figure
components.description: Architecture drawn in interface materials: hairline nodes, drawn arrows, a hairline-divided module grid, one amber-line core. No enclosing panel.
components.css: .ds-fig{margin:0;display:grid;gap:4px;font-family:var(--font-body,'Schibsted Grotesk',sans-serif)}.ds-fig-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.ds-node{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:var(--radius-control,8px);border:1px solid var(--color-rule,oklch(89.5% .004 85));background:var(--color-paper,oklch(98.6% .003 85))}.ds-node p,.ds-mono-head p{margin:0;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--color-ink,oklch(21% .008 260))}.ds-node small{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--color-muted,oklch(49% .01 260))}.ds-core{border-color:var(--color-accent-line,oklch(55% .13 66))}.ds-arrow{display:block;width:12px;height:28px;margin:0 auto;color:var(--color-muted,oklch(49% .01 260))}.ds-mono{overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--radius-control,8px);border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--color-ink-2,oklch(36% .008 260)) 50%,transparent);background:var(--color-paper,oklch(98.6% .003 85))}.ds-mono-head{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule,oklch(89.5% .004 85))}.ds-mono ul{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;background:var(--color-rule,oklch(89.5% .004 85))}.ds-mono li{padding:8px 12px;background:var(--color-paper,oklch(98.6% .003 85));font-size:.75rem;color:var(--color-ink-2,oklch(36% .008 260))}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Annotated Record"**

A calm, exact working record set on daylight paper. Who he is stays fixed in view; the work scrolls past as a plain list of evidence: real screenshots, one drawn system figure, a muted line naming the stack, dates in tabular figures. Nothing performs. Hierarchy comes from one grotesk family at three weights, graphite ink in three strengths, and hairline rules; colour is spent on a single amber that marks the next action and the current place.

Density is reading density, not dashboard density: generous section gaps, a 65ch measure for running text, and lists separated by hairlines rather than boxed into cards or decorated with pills. Dark mode is the same record after hours: graphite paper (not black), warm off-white ink, and the very same amber. Print is a third theme: paper is paper whatever the screen says, and every amber role drops to ink.

The system refuses the developer-portfolio costume: navy and teal, neon glow, badge walls, card grids, typing headers.
keyCharacteristics: One family (Schibsted Grotesk), weights 400, 600 and 700 only; monospace for inline code alone.
Warm paper neutrals (hue 85) against cool graphite ink (hue 260); amber is the only chroma.
One amber in two jobs: a light fill behind graphite text, and a deeper line for marks drawn on paper.
Hairline rules (1px) do the structural work; text, not chips, carries metadata.
Three themes from one token set: light, dark, print.
44px minimum hit area on every control.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber marks action and location, nothing else: the primary button, the active nav line, link hover, focus, the system's core node. Never a section fill, a heading colour, or decoration.

rules.name: The Fill and Line Rule
rules.body: Amber as a surface uses the fill with graphite text on it; amber as a 1px mark on paper uses the line token. Never draw a thin mark in the fill colour on light paper.

rules.name: The Warm Paper, Cool Ink Rule
rules.body: Paper neutrals sit at hue 85, ink at hue 260, both at chroma 0.01 or below. New neutrals pick a side; none sit between.

rules.name: The Paper Is Paper Rule
rules.body: In print the palette collapses to near-white paper and near-black ink, every amber role (fill, text on fill, line) maps to ink or paper, and no shadow or border frames the sheet.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 reads, 600 labels and acts, 700 names. No 300, 500 or 800; font synthesis is off.

rules.name: The Tabular Dates Rule
rules.body: Dates and figures set with tabular numerals, in a fixed 9rem gutter or right-aligned, so they scan as a column.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are short sentence-case words in the label style, muted when they group content. No uppercase tracked micro-labels above headings.

rules.name: The Stack Is a Sentence Rule
rules.body: Technologies are listed as one muted, comma-separated caption line, never as chips or badges.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px rule or a paper-2 tone. A shadow is reserved for a surface that is literally a sheet of paper.

dos: **Do** spend amber only on the primary action, the active location, link hover, focus and the system's core node.
**Do** use the amber fill as a surface with graphite text, and the amber-line token for every 1px amber mark.
**Do** set every surface in Schibsted Grotesk at 400, 600 or 700, with hierarchy from weight and ink strength.
**Do** separate list rows with a 1px hairline and let section gaps (72 to 112px) carry the structure.
**Do** list technologies as one muted comma-separated line.
**Do** draw diagrams as hairline boxes and drawn arrows on the page itself, with one amber-line node at most.
**Do** give every control a 44px minimum hit area and a 2px amber-line focus outline at 2px offset.
**Do** define any new colour for light, dark and print together.
**Do** set dates and figures in tabular numerals.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent hue, gradients on content, or glow effects.
**Don't** render stack, skills or categories as pills, chips or badges.
**Don't** box secondary items into card grids or nest a card inside a card.
**Don't** add drop shadows to cards, buttons or figures; the document lift belongs to the resume sheet alone.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked micro-labels above headings; labels are sentence case.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface for display; monospace is for inline code only.
**Don't** use decorative illustration or stock imagery; pictures are real screenshots or drawn system figures.
